macro_analysis.narrative: Between 2020 and 2026, the US 10-Year Treasury Yield (^TNX) transitioned from pandemic lows near 0.52% to multi-decade highs above 4.90% during the Federal Reserve's tightening cycle. During 60-day windows dominated by inflation shocks (2022), the correlation between Δ10Y Yield and S&P 500 returns turned deeply negative as long-duration tech multiples compressed, whereas AI-driven earnings growth in 2023–2026 allowed cash-rich mega-caps (NVDA, MSFT, META, AVGO) to decouple from higher-for-longer discount rates.

verified_events.title: COVID-19 Circuit Breaker & Emergency Fed Zero-Rate Cut
verified_events.explanation: S&P 500 triggered Level-1 circuit breakers despite the Federal Reserve cutting rates to 0.00%–0.25% and launching $700B QE.
verified_events.source: Federal Reserve FOMC Statement & NYSE Circuit Breaker Log (Mar 16, 2020)

verified_events.title: Apple Blowout Q3 FY20 Earnings & 4-for-1 Stock Split Announcement
verified_events.explanation: Apple reported $59.7B quarterly revenue (+11% YoY) alongside a 4-for-1 stock split, igniting a massive single-day breakout.

verified_events.title: Tesla Crosses $1 Trillion Market Cap on Hertz 100,000-EV Order
verified_events.explanation: Tesla surged past a $1T valuation after Hertz announced a landmark order for 100,000 Model 3 vehicles and Morgan Stanley raised its price target.
verified_events.source: Bloomberg & SEC Market Cap Milestone Records (Oct 25, 2021)

verified_events.title: Meta Q4 FY21 Earnings Miss & Apple iOS ATT Privacy Headwind (-26.4%)
verified_events.explanation: Meta suffered the largest single-day market-cap wipeout in US history ($232B) after guiding to $10B in revenue headwinds from Apple's ATT privacy changes.
verified_events.source: Meta Platforms SEC Form 8-K & Q4 2021 Earnings Release (Feb 2–3, 2022)

verified_events.title: Amazon Q4 Holiday Beat, Prime Price Hike & AWS Margin Expansion
verified_events.explanation: Amazon surged +13.5% after AWS revenue accelerated +40% YoY to $17.8B and management raised US Prime membership pricing.

verified_events.title: August 2022 US CPI Inflation Shock (8.3% YoY) & 10Y Yield Surge
verified_events.explanation: Core CPI unexpectedly accelerated to 6.3% YoY, cementing expectations for a third consecutive 75 bps Fed hike and triggering the worst S&P 500 drop since 2020.
verified_events.source: US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) CPI Report (Sep 13, 2022)

verified_events.title: Meta 'Year of Efficiency' Restructuring & $40B Share Buyback (+23.3%)
verified_events.explanation: Mark Zuckerberg declared 2023 the 'Year of Efficiency', slashing OpEx guidance by $5B and authorizing a $40B share repurchase program.
verified_events.source: Meta Platforms SEC Form 8-K & Q4 2022 Earnings Call (Feb 1–2, 2023)

verified_events.title: NVIDIA Q1 FY24 Data Center AI Guidance Shock (+24.4% Single-Day Surge)
verified_events.explanation: NVIDIA guided Q2 revenue to $11.0B vs $7.15B consensus (+54% surprise) driven by generative AI H100 GPU demand from hyperscalers.
verified_events.source: NVIDIA SEC Form 8-K & Q1 FY24 Financial Results (May 24–25, 2023)

verified_events.title: NVIDIA Q4 FY24 Triple-Digit Data Center Revenue Surge (+409% YoY)
verified_events.explanation: Data Center revenue reached $18.4B (+409% YoY), propelling NVDA +16.4% in a single day and lifting the entire S&P 500 and semiconductor sector.

verified_events.title: Broadcom AI Custom Accelerator Surge & 10-for-1 Stock Split (+12.3%)
verified_events.explanation: Broadcom raised full-year AI semiconductor revenue guidance to $11B+ and announced a 10-for-1 stock split, confirming hyperscaler ASIC adoption.
verified_events.source: Broadcom Inc. SEC Form 10-Q & Q2 FY24 Release (Jun 12–13, 2024)
